purpose: Fairly test whether the frozen Final16 Processor adds future-evolution skill beyond persistence of the model's own current-field reconstruction

contract.target_reference: ERA5T reanalysis, not direct station truth

baseline_definition.name: input_compatible_reconstruction_persistence
baseline_definition.inputs: identical last 12 h real operational input tensor used by Final16
baseline_definition.path: Final16 encoder -> last historical latent -> Final16 reconstruction_decoder -> current 31x33 field -> repeat unchanged over +1...+6 h
baseline_definition.dense_era5t_persistence_note: Uses the complete ERA5T analysis grid at forecast origin and therefore has strictly stronger input information than the operational model

v9_2_vs_input_compatible_reconstruction_.definition: 1 - RMSE_v9_2_final16 / RMSE_baseline; positive means V9.2 is better

v9_2_vs_dense_era5t_persistence.definition: 1 - RMSE_v9_2_final16 / RMSE_baseline; positive means V9.2 is better

v9_2_vs_v9_1_frozen.definition: 1 - RMSE_v9_2_final16 / RMSE_baseline; positive means V9.2 is better

timeline.lead_alignment: +1 through +6 hours from the last historical input

integrity_checks.tp_semantics: Unchanged from the existing operational evaluation: hourly ERA5T TP at each lead; six-hour event TP is sum(max(tp_hourly_mm, 0)) over +1...+6

old_evaluation_comparison.comparison: recursive exact equality of every aggregate and per-lead MAE/RMSE value
